summary: DRAFT, NOT VERIFIED: written from general knowledge to show the import format. Check every value against the sources below and set verified_at before agents may use it. Russian citizens need a Schengen type C visa for tourist stays in Hungary of up to 90 days in any 180-day period.

requirements.title: Valid passport
requirements.description: Issued within the last 10 years, valid at least 3 months after the planned departure from the Schengen area, with at least 2 blank pages.

requirements.title: Completed Schengen visa application form
requirements.description: Harmonised Schengen application form, signed by the applicant.

requirements.title: Biometric photo
requirements.description: 35 × 45 mm, light background, taken within the last 6 months.

requirements.title: Travel medical insurance
requirements.description: Covers the whole stay in the Schengen area, minimum cover EUR 30,000, including medical repatriation.

requirements.title: Proof of accommodation
requirements.description: Hotel booking, rental agreement or an invitation from a host for every night of the stay.

requirements.title: Proof of sufficient funds
requirements.description: Recent bank statements showing enough money for the stay and the return journey.

requirements.title: Travel itinerary
requirements.description: Return ticket or booking showing entry and exit dates.

fees.title: Visa application centre service fee
fees.note: Set by the visa centre; check when booking.

steps.title: Book a visa appointment
steps.description: Applications can be submitted at most 6 months and at the latest 15 days before travel.

steps.title: Collect all required documents
steps.description: Gather everything on the checklist before the appointment.

steps.title: Pay the visa fee
steps.description: Paid at the appointment or in advance, depending on the visa centre.

steps.title: Submit the application and give biometrics
steps.description: Fingerprints are taken unless given in the last 59 months.

steps.title: Collect the passport with the decision
steps.description: Standard processing is 15 calendar days and can be extended.

sources.title: European Commission: applying for a Schengen visa
